name: Bearnie · Components

description.zh: 具体条目内容细节展示。 Bearnie 提供 50+ 个面向 Astro 与 Tailwind CSS 的可访问组件，采用 shadcn 式源码安装流程：运行 npx bearnie init 后，组件代码会被复制进项目，可自行改样式和扩展。文档侧列出 Accordion、Alert Dialog、Button、Calendar、Carousel、Combobox 等组件入口，并提供 CLI 与 MCP Server 说明页。

reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by Bearnie (https://bearnie.dev/).
Technology stack: tailwind, css.
Component specification: 具体条目内容细节展示。


Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
